notes: Provided by implementation/server/index.ts, worker.ts and web/live.ts. Routes and messages are in interfaces/wire.md. The directory object is not provided here: rooms call the DIRECTORY namespace, which the application binds to the class from room-directory (createDirectoryClass); see interfaces/required/room-directory.json.

settings.allowedOrigins: string[], exact origins allowed to call the worker, in Settings
settings.roomPrefix: string including its separator, in Settings

types.Services: {identity:IdentityService,videoGrant?:(request:Request)=>Promise<Response>} (identity is the guest-identity component, see interfaces/required/guest-identity.json)

createRoomClass.returns: class Room extends DurableObject (export a concrete subclass named Room)

routes.GET /r/:room/state?since=VERSION: private view, long poll up to 25 seconds
